title: Rattan lattice in the sun bar

tokens.v: Set it on bare boards square in the late bar of sun and let the open weave shred the light into a lattice running toward the lens and out the bottom edge; the dormer and rafters climb out through the top. 28mm at f/4, camera flat on the boards at rim height. Cold blue skylight from the far gable washes the shadowed half of the boards so the warm bar reads against it. A small dark leather tab riveted to the rolled rim carries a blind-debossed unlettered maker's mark, shadow pooling in the impression. The out-of-focus corner of a folded wool throw crosses the bottom-right corner, cut by the right edge.
